story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: You talked about The Strollers club. I just want to paint a little bit more picture…
It was, believe it or not, I don’t think I ever went there.
A lotta terrific musicians played out there [all the time?].
Shelly’s? Did he have his club yet, or was that much later?
That was a bit later. I actually played Shelly’s Manhole.
Any other places come to mind?
Let me see… They probably were, will, after you’ve gone to sleep tonight.
